newsitem.title: USA: Dow seen heading lower at start.
newsitem.headline: Dow seen heading lower at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open lower with bonds on Wednesday after a rally which took the Dow industrials to two consecutive closing highs.
Analysts said that weakness in Cisco Systems Inc following its third quarter earnings could color the market, putting pressure on the high techs.

"The market has run the one-minute mile and is entitled to a pause," said Prudentail Securities analyst Larry Wachtel "The bond market, the gatekeepr for stocks, is down. It looks stretched. Yesterday's auction did not go that well."
